description: This Java source file defines a BookServer class that sets up an HTTP server using Netty to serve book data via REST endpoints (/get_books and /get_book). It includes server initialization, request handling, and book data management.

classes.name: BookServer
classes.description: Main class that initializes and runs an HTTP server to serve book data, with internal handler class for processing requests.

classes.name: BookHandler
classes.description: Inner class extending SimpleChannelInboundHandler to handle HTTP requests for retrieving book data.

methods.name: startServer
methods.description: Initializes and starts the Netty server, binding to specified port, with optional SSL support.

methods.name: createBookData
methods.description: Creates and populates the in-memory database of books.

methods.name: getBooksDB
methods.description: Returns the current book database map.

methods.name: stopServer
methods.description: Stops the server, printing a message.
